testsuite.name: model.ColumnStatsTest

testcase.name: bounds in the example table decode to their real values()
a column mentioned by only one statistics map still gets a row()
without a schema the counts still come through and the bounds stay undecoded()
the manifest carries the schema its bounds were written against()
an all-null column is flagged so an absent bound is explained()
